nodes.name: Dashboard Question In
nodes.notes: READ-ONLY endpoint for the Signal dashboard. Never wire Notion write nodes into this workflow. 'Allowed Origins (CORS)' is set to * — tighten this to your actual site origin before real deployment.

nodes.name: Build Read-Only Prompt
nodes.notes: AUTH: set REQUIRE_AUTH=false to bypass while testing, true to enforce. SHARED_SECRET must exactly match the token pasted into the dashboard Settings. Do not reuse the Teams webhook secret.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'ilmu-v3.1', temperature: 0.3, max_tokens: 700, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: $json.systemContext }, { role: 'user', content: $json.question } ] }) }}

nodes.name: Ask ILMU
nodes.notes: Endpoint confirmed from the ILMU provider config: baseUrl https://api.ilmu.ai/v1 with api type 'openai-completions', so the chat path is /v1/chat/completions. MODEL: use ilmu-v3.1 for chat. Do NOT use bge-m3 (that is an embedding model, no chat capability) or 'nemo-super' (an n8n node display name, not a real model id). To list what this endpoint actually serves: GET https://api.ilmu.ai/v1/models with the same bearer credential.

nodes.name: Respond to Dashboard
